tools.name: computer_capabilities
tools.description: Report backend versions, supported actions, permissions and grounder state.

tools.name: computer_start_session
tools.description: Start a supervised session on a user-selected target window.

tools.name: computer_observe
tools.description: Return a structured, bounded observation of the session target.

tools.name: computer_find
tools.description: Resolve a target description to an opaque handle via accessibility or vision.

tools.name: computer_act
tools.description: Execute one authorized atomic action against a resolved target handle.

tools.name: computer_verify
tools.description: Check an expected state against a fresh observation.

tools.name: computer_request_handoff
tools.description: Revoke automatic input until a trusted resume.

tools.name: computer_resume_after_handoff
tools.description: Resume with host approval and a fresh observation.

tools.name: computer_stop_session
tools.description: Idempotently cancel and release the session.
